:::{#exm-wcgs-strat-from-contrast}

#### Converting the fitted WCGS coefficients

The code below applies @thm-wcgs-strat-from-contrast to the coefficients of the fitted corner-point model (`chd_glm_contrasts`),
and compares the result with the coefficients of the model fitted directly with the stratified parametrization (`chd_glm_strat`):

```{r}
#| label: exm-wcgs-strat-from-contrast-calc
#| code-fold: show
ex_b <- coef(chd_glm_contrasts)
ex_converted <- c(
  "dibpatType B" = unname(ex_b["(Intercept)"]),
  "dibpatType A" = unname(ex_b["(Intercept)"] + ex_b["dibpatType A"]),
  "dibpatType B:age" = unname(ex_b["age"]),
  "dibpatType A:age" = unname(ex_b["age"] + ex_b["dibpatType A:age"])
)
ex_direct <- coef(chd_glm_strat)[names(ex_converted)]
ex_max_gap <- max(abs(ex_converted - ex_direct))
```

The largest difference between the converted coefficients and the directly fitted ones is
`r format(ex_max_gap, digits = 2)`,
which is zero up to numerical error.

:::
